# CV SURGERY (OPEN HEART) MVAHCS POSTOPERATIVE PROPHYLAXIS RECOMMENDATIONS

Place post-op IV antimicrobial prophylaxis orders after admission to ward.

Duration of antimicrobial prophylaxis should not exceed 24 hours. Durations

longer than 24 hours have not been shown effective in preventing cardiothoracic

surgical site infections. There is no benefit to continuing antimicrobial

prophylaxis until all indwelling drains and intravascular catheters are removed.

For CIED surgery postoperative antimicrobial prophylaxis click link below:

[CIED Surgery Postoperative Prophylaxis](surg-vascular-surg-postop)

# CV Surgery (including CAB and TAVR) Postoperative Prophylaxis

[Cefuroxime 1.5 gm IV q8h x 1 dose post-op \($$\) R <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg](orz-set-abx-cefur-1-5g-vanco-15mg-kg-postop-card)

(pharmacy to dose) IV q12h x 1 dose post-op ($) [R]

Alternative for patient with cephalosporin allergy

Levofloxacin has a duration of action of 24 hours. If patient received a pre-op

dose of levofloxacin, a post-op dose is not required.

[Vancomycin 15 mg/kg \(pharmacy to dose\) IV q12h x 1 dose post-op \($\) R](psjizid-vancomycin-15mg-kg-postoperative-q12h-once)

References:

Bratzler DW et al, Clinical Practice Guidelines for Antimicrobial Prophylaxis in

Surgery, Am J Health-Syst Pharm (2013) 70:195-283
